scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('public/icons',{recursive:true});for(const s of ['512','192','180']){fs.writeFileSync('public/icons/icon-'+s+'.png',Buffer.from(fs.readFileSync('public/icons-src/icon-'+s+'.b64','utf8').trim(),'base64'))}console.log('PWA icons decoded from icons-src')"
